review_text: Finally, web based app is here. Loving it. I feel that Esewa is best digital payment portal till date. author: A Google user
review_text: One of the best apps in Nepal! Easy to make payments... and unlike some other apps that require internet, it doesn't need internet data to work. It utilizes SMS to work, and that is free in NTC! The only thing I need badly on Esewa is the ability to add funds from Nepal Investment Bank.
